notes.title: REMIX MODE: FINAL EPISODE OUT NOW
notes.content:
After 2 years, the conclusion to the story of LUMbA: HANGOVER is finally here!

Just make sure the game is updated, go into "REMIX MODE" and select Episode 4. The final battle between Lumba and Pal begins today.

notes.title: GLEEK Update
notes.content: A brand new feature has been added. Go find it.

notes.title: REMIX MODE EPISODE 3 - OUT NOW
notes.content: Just popping in to let everyone know that REMIX MODE EPISODE 3 was released earlier this month. I've been really busy for quite a bit, so I kinda forgot to make the announcement here. I don't have an estimated release date for EP 4 yet, but rest assured, it's gonna be awesome.

notes.title: REMIX MODE EPISODES 1 - 2 OUT NOW!!!
notes.content:
Today is the anniversary of the original LUMbA, which was released on Itch.Io 2 years ago on this very day. We felt now would be the best time to release the first 2 episodes of the brand new REMIX MODE! Just boot up the game, click "REMIX MODE" on the menu, and you should be good to go. I have so much homework rn its actually crazy, I'm legit working on a research paper as a write this, so I'm sorry about the lack of any actual buildup to this but I'm busy lol.

[b]REMIX MODE EPISODE 3 COMING LATE SUMMER 2024[/b]

notes.title: UI Fix (maybe)
notes.content:
There was a bug where some UI elements didn't scale properly with the rest of the screen, and I [i]think [/i]I fixed it? I'm pretty sure I did but I can't be sure that the UI will work properly on all resolutions, if you see anything weird just dm me on discord and I'll figure something out.

In other news, I've been really hard at work on the cool new content update. Its getting pretty big, and I'm happy with how its turning out so far. I think I've settled on the release date of-

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43159243/be2289c0406ddb8a96902c87c2a0d30ac4ecdfa2.jpg[/img]

yikes! it looks like the ballin cat has struck again! i was unable to announce the release date in time :(

notes.title: Steam Deck Patch
notes.content:
[h1]I LOVE FIXING BUGS![/h1]
Santa got me a Steam Deck and it's pretty cool, but you know what's not cool? Unity's video player. The thing didn't work at all while playing hangover on the deck. All assets that used mp4 files were all whacked out and stuff, so I rushed to work on a patch. I found out [strike]in a Reddit post[/strike] all by myself that the shit wasn't being encoded or something tbh I already forgot what the problem was but it's fixed now.

Also, I did something else:

[h1]official Steaminput controls!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!![/h1]

If you're playing on the steam deck, I made a controller preset to assist you in your operations
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43159243/5d024aef275ee3ed2a87313aaddab60989ab86dc.png[/img].
I think I made it public but its not showing up when I search for it, this stuff is all new to me as I'm really dumb and stupid and not very smart and am pretty dumb.

If you notice any issues that have come from this patch, or notice issues in the Steam Deck version that I didn't notice, reach out to me on discord.

notes.title: LUMbA: HANGOVER REMIX COMING SOON
notes.content:
LUMbA: HANGOVER's brand new [b]Remix Mode[/b] takes the entire campaign and transforms it into something new.

[list]
[*] The levels have been transformed, with altered layouts, visuals, and enemies.
[*] The boss fights are all brand new, with varying levels of absurdity.
[*] A brand new story, taking place after the events of the main campaign.
[*] Our lord and savior Neatneet has returned to bring new music to this dying game!
[/list]
